content.text:
ls: cannot access 'apps/sva-studio-react/packages/data/migrations': No such file or directory
---real vite/nitro server proc---

observation.command:
cd /workspace && ls -d apps/sva-studio-react/packages/data/migrations 2>&1; echo "---real vite/nitro server proc---"
for pid in $(pgrep -x node | sort -n); do
  cwd=$(readlink /proc/$pid/cwd 2>/dev/null)
  exe=$(tr '\0' ' ' < /proc/$pid/cmdline 2>/dev/null)
  # find processes whose cwd is the app root (not workspace root)
  case "$cwd" in
    */apps/sva-studio-react) echo "pid=$pid cwd=$cwd :: ${exe:0:80}" ;;
  esac
done 2>/dev/null
